0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>After all that traipsing around the desert, you finally have the chance to do something heroic.

24.original: Search for the girl's brother and defeat the yeheheceyaa.

26.original: Speak with the strapping young lad.

49.original: Me and my brother were cloudfishing, and we were attacked by a yeheheceyaa! He told me to run, so I did, but he stayed behind to fight it!

50.original: He's still down by the cliffs, and if you hurry, you'll make it in time! You'll go help him, won't you?

51.original: Please, you have to save him!

52.original: Thank you... If you hadn't turned up when you did, I'd be a goner for sure!

53.original: I'd better go let my sister know I'm all right. Besides, it ain't safe here, so I suggest you head back to town as well. Maybe I'll see you there?

54.original: You did it! My brother's alive, and it's all because of you!

55.original: Good to see you again. So my sister is the one who sent you to rescue me? Looks like I owe my life to both of you!

56.original: Truth be told, a yeheheceyaa is the last thing I expected to see, never mind being attacked by one. They must've expanded their territory or something, so I'd better stay away from the cliff tops for a while.

57.original: That said, we make our living off the creatures we catch there, so we can't give up on cloudfishing altogether. I suppose the nearest safe spot would be somewhere near the bridge to Tuliyollal, which is kind of far from here... Still, better than no fishing at all!

58.original: Speaking of which, it's time to go snag us some more fish! Thanks again, friend. Stay safe out there, you hear?
